question: Does the official approximately nine-sketch poster layout uniquely belong to the sticker-bearing CE, and is there any authored A-I foreground reading rule?

claims: Includes fold-out poster with exclusive original art
Limited PS4 physical edition distinct from statue CE

same_scene_evidence.observation: Both official galleries display the same distinctive oblique photo scene: unfolded white INSIDE poster on industrial metal grid beside blue PlayStation case/disc; identical nine roughly 3x3 concept sketches and relative placement.
same_scene_evidence.image_variant_difference: CE gallery uses _cf6a9295-f926-4f34-880f-2ddd6d75ce3d suffix; standalone uses unsuffixed filename. Files not byte-hash compared.
same_scene_evidence.what_it_establishes: Publisher reused the poster photograph to promote both distinct products, so this image by itself cannot establish CE exclusivity of the visible 3x3 sketch grid.
same_scene_evidence.what_it_does_not_establish: The exact physical sheet inserted in standalone vs CE copies, the reverse-side artwork, or any source-defined A-I glyph alignment.

poster_front_as_pictured.medium: Single oblique lifestyle image, not an orthographic or print-ready scan.
poster_front_as_pictured.surface_status: Authentic source image; a registered foreground receiving surface has not been shown.

comparison_control.single_product_prior: A nine-sketch visual arrangement on publisher material is an economical visual analogy but not independently CE-only.
comparison_control.cross_product_marketing_prior: The identical promotional scene is used on standalone listing, weakening any assertion that the photograph itself proves a CE-specific sticker guide.
comparison_control.design_caveat: Even if the standalone physical poster is identical, Playdead could have intended a metapuzzle that standalone purchasers solve with other media; artwork sharing is not logically disproof of sticker use.
unavailable_externals: Verified standalone unboxing with unfolded sheet in both orientations
Verified CE unboxing with front/back scans at matched geometry
Publisher-authored statement identifying poster grid as a code matrix

other_pack_ins.source_observation: Official photos show numerous assorted image cards, not an obvious nine-card A-I sequence. Exact quantity and any reverse-side numbering not confirmed.
other_pack_ins.do_not_infer: Nine sticker backgrounds do not require nine physical art cards.

proposed_source_fixed_next_test: Acquire native unfolded poster front and back, plus source evidence of which edition each scan belongs to.
Determine independently whether both physical editions shipped the same print. Preserve original orientation and fold registration.
Before overlaying sticker predictions, establish author-provided A-I label correspondence, print margin/index, or at least a repeatable operation shared across two independent source art assets.
Use the high-resolution original not an unconstrained perspective warp. If no authored mapping is found, treat the poster as an art display rather than a cipher consumer.
